arguments.message: Hi there – if you see an admin you don’t recognize, the first step is to remove that user right away (Settings → People). After you’ve removed them, please report the incident to our support team so we can review how the admin was added and determine whether any further action, such as locking down the account, is needed. Our security team will investigate the invite and access history on a case‑by‑case basis.
